text:
mira (docs): Hey team — ran the weekly link-scan against staging and noticed a cluster of 404s in the runtime guide under /runtime/kv-cache. Saw it while validating the CHANGELOG links.
alex (runtime): Can you paste the failing URLs? I can take a look after stand.
mira (docs): Sure — top offenders: `/runtime/kv-cache#best-practices`, `/runtime/kv-cache/advanced-caching` and the inline curl example that references `docs.redwood.ai/runtime/old-kv`.
mira (docs): Quick grep output:
```
$ grep -R "old-kv" docs/runtime | sed -n '1,5p'
docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:45:curl https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/old-kv -o example.json
```
link-bot: Link-scan: 3 broken links found in /runtime/kv-cache.md (PR suggested: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1227) :link:
sam (infra): FYI a recent redirect change on the CDN may have dropped `/runtime/old-kv` — I can check the CDN rules in ~30m.
julie (eng): If this is just redirects, small PR to re-point the example to `/runtime/kv-cache/examples` should be fine. Happy to review. :+1:
alex (runtime): I'll own the doc fix & small redirect fallback. Planning: (1) update curl example to new path, (2) add a short note about canonical slug, (3) open PR and ping for CR. ETA today EOD.
mira (docs): Awesome — could you include a short unit test for the snippet render? We've seen flakey snippet rendering in prod previews.
alex (runtime): Yep. I'll add a minimal smoke check in the docs CI that curls the example path and checks 200.
sam (infra): On the CDN side I found a rule that was accidentally matching `runtime/old-*`. I toggled a safer rule to staging; will promote to prod once PR merges.
mira (docs): Thanks. @julie can you review the PR once alex opens it? Also can someone update the docs-owners file to add runtime group as a fallback owner?
julie (eng): Yep I can review. I'll also add the fallback owner entry.
link-bot: Suggested PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1227 (created by alex/runtime-fix-kv-404)
alex (runtime): PR opened. Short description + CI smoke. tagging @julie and @mira for review.
mira (docs): Reviewing now. Small nit: change `old-kv` mention to `kv-cache legacy path` in the blurb. Otherwise looks good.
julie (eng): Approved, left one tiny wording nit. :white_check_mark:
sam (infra): CDN rule will be promoted in 10m after merge.
alex (runtime): Merged. Thanks everyone. Marking this thread resolved — I updated the docs-owners and added a quick entry to the sprint tasks for a broader link audit next week.
mira (docs): Great follow-up. Can we add a short note in the release checklist to run the link-scan pre-release? Saves us these surprise finds.
julie (eng): Good call. I'll add it to the checklist.
mira (docs): OK closing. Thanks :party-parrot:
